cocoa-2024.lineage: For each of the release's source tiles: gdal_translate -ovr 4 (the 347 px internal overview, as published, unchanged). Then gdalbuildvrt -vrtnodata nan over the extracts, and gdal_translate -of COG -co COMPRESS=ZSTD -co PREDICTOR=YES -co BLOCKSIZE=512 -co OVERVIEW_RESAMPLING=AVERAGE -co STATISTICS=YES. Script: tools/build_overview.sh.
